Format.description: The file's format name; first key of the file.

Version.description: The format version this build writes; older versions are migrated when read.

Name.description: The behaviour's Script.Define name: a Luau identifier of 1 to 64 bytes that is not a reserved word and does not start with "__".

RunsWhileWorldPaused.description: Whether the behaviour updates while the world is paused (Time.PauseWorld), as a Luau class that sets RunsWhileWorldPaused.

Fields.description: At most 128 fields, sorted by Name.

Variables.description: At most 128 variables, sorted by Name.

Methods.description: At most 64 methods, sorted by Name.

Nodes.description: At most 4096 nodes, sorted by Id.

Links.description: At most 16384 links, sorted by (From.Node, From.Pin, To.Node, To.Pin) byte-wise, each once, joining two different nodes.

GraphField.description: A behaviour field, set per script slot (§6.11).

Name.description: A Luau identifier, unique across fields, variables and methods (§6.11).

Kind.description: Its Luau Field constructor; never Any.

Default.description: Its default, in its Kind's JSON spelling (§6.11).

Element.description: An Array's element kind; Number otherwise.

Options.description: Its Luau FieldOptions: Min, Max, Step, Tooltip (§6.11).

GraphVariable.description: Instance state, set to its Default at OnCreate (§6.11).

Name.description: A Luau identifier, unique across fields, variables and methods (§6.11).

Kind.description: Its kind, as a field's, or Any.

Default.description: Its default, in its Kind's JSON spelling (§6.11).

Element.description: An Array's element kind; Number otherwise.

GraphMethod.description: A method of the behaviour, which scripts call on its instance and its Method.<Name> nodes run (§6.11).

Name.description: A Luau identifier, not a reserved name, unique across fields, variables and methods.

Parameters.description: At most 4 parameters, in call order.

Results.description: At most 1 result; empty when the method returns nothing.

GraphNode.description: One node: a node kind of the library at a place on the canvas, with literals of its input pins.

Id.description: From 1 to 2147483647, unique in the graph and stable for the node's life.

Kind.description: Its node kind: 1 to 256 bytes of dot-separated parts of letters, digits and '_' (Flow.Branch, Call.Input.GetAxis, Self.Get.Speed; graph.nodes lists them).

Position.description: The canvas place of its top-left corner, each component finite and within 1000000 of the origin; layout only.

Values.description: At most 64 literals of its input pins by pin name: null, a boolean, a finite number, a string of at most 4096 bytes of UTF-8, or an array of 3 or 4 finite numbers (a vector, a colour, a quaternion). A linked input keeps its literal, and the link wins.

GraphLink.description: A link from an output pin of one node to an input pin of another.

GraphParameter.description: A parameter of a graph method.

Name.description: A Luau identifier other than self and Then, unique in its method.

Kind.description: Its kind: any but Enum and Array.

AssetType.description: An Asset's AssetType, or empty for any asset; empty otherwise.

GraphResult.description: The result of a graph method.

Kind.description: Its kind: any but Enum and Array.

AssetType.description: An Asset's AssetType, or empty for any asset; empty otherwise.

GraphPinRef.description: One pin of one node: an end of a link.

Pin.description: The pin's name, a Luau identifier of 1 to 64 bytes (graph.nodes lists each kind's pins).
